name: Data Science
description: From statistics and pandas to end-to-end projects — the complete foundation for turning raw data into decisions.

items.title: Kaggle Learn — Data Science
items.description: Hands-on micro-courses covering pandas, EDA and modeling.

items.title: Python for Data Analysis — Wes McKinney
items.description: The definitive guide to pandas and the PyData stack.

items.title: Pandas User Guide
items.description: Official documentation for the pandas data-analysis library.

items.title: scikit-learn User Guide
items.description: Authoritative guide to the Python machine-learning toolbox.

lessons.title: What Is Data Science?
lessons.description: Define data science, understand its core disciplines, and map the roles and workflow of a modern data team.

lessons.title: The Data Science Pipeline
lessons.description: Walk through the six stages of a data science project and learn where real projects fail — and why iteration matters.

lessons.title: Python for Data Science
lessons.description: The Python fundamentals every data scientist leans on: collections, comprehensions, file I/O, and reproducible notebooks.

lessons.title: NumPy: Arrays & Vectorization
lessons.description: Master the n-dimensional array, vectorized operations, and the broadcasting rules that make Python fast.

lessons.title: Pandas: DataFrames & Series
lessons.description: Load, inspect, filter, group and merge tabular data with the most important library in data science.

lessons.title: Data Cleaning & Wrangling
lessons.description: Fix missing values, wrong types, duplicates and inconsistent text — the 60–80% of real data work.

lessons.title: Exploratory Data Analysis
lessons.description: Use summaries and plots to interrogate a dataset before any modeling — find patterns, outliers and bugs.

lessons.title: Data Visualization
lessons.description: Build clear, honest charts with Matplotlib and Seaborn — and learn which chart answers which question.

lessons.title: Statistics Fundamentals
lessons.description: Descriptive statistics, samples vs populations, and the distributions that data science runs on.

lessons.title: Probability Distributions
lessons.description: The distributions behind data science: Bernoulli, binomial, Poisson, normal and more — and when to use each.

lessons.title: Hypothesis Testing
lessons.description: Null hypotheses, p-values, t-tests and the statistical decisions that separate real effects from noise.

lessons.title: Correlation & Causation
lessons.description: Measure correlation, then learn why correlation is not causation — and how to actually establish causes.

lessons.title: Feature Engineering
lessons.description: Turn raw data into features models can learn from: encodings, scaling, transforms and derived variables.

lessons.title: Train/Test Splits & Validation
lessons.description: Split data honestly, avoid leakage, and use holdout sets and cross-validation to measure real performance.

lessons.title: Regression Models
lessons.description: Predict continuous values with linear and regularized regression, and read the results honestly.

lessons.title: Classification Models
lessons.description: Predict categories with logistic regression, decision trees and k-NN — and understand what a classifier actually outputs.

lessons.title: Clustering
lessons.description: Discover structure in unlabeled data with k-means and hierarchical clustering — and evaluate the result.

lessons.title: Model Evaluation Metrics
lessons.description: Accuracy, precision, recall, F1, ROC-AUC and confusion matrices — the honest measurement of model quality.

lessons.title: Communicating Results
lessons.description: Turn analysis into decisions: structure a finding, choose the right chart, and write for stakeholders.

lessons.title: An End-to-End Data Science Project
lessons.description: Combine everything into a real project: from a raw dataset to a working, honestly-evaluated model.

lessons.title: Beyond the Basics: Your Data Science Roadmap
lessons.description: Where to go after this course: specializations, projects, and the learning paths that lead to a career.
